headline: The Cinder Wyrm grew a real body
lede: Emberwood's boss tail was riding the shared item-sprite pool — flat, unrotated, and stealing drop billboards. It now has 20 dedicated ridge plates that orient, shingle, taper and flash along the spine.

notes.text: Tail plates orient along the spine tangent, z-shingle head to tip (7.8 to 4.2) and lift as the Wyrm drives — the body reads as a body now.
The drop pool is free: drops are no longer hidden whenever the Wyrm is on screen.
emberwoodcheck 151/151 (116 node + 30 Chrome): +4 spine-chain gates, +5 tail gates; mutant (frozen yaw) turns the orientation gate red and only that gate.
Sim byte-identical — hash-neutral, the attract proof route is untouched.
